symptom: ako/mxcli#1563 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1631): `alter page … replace cbBooking with { combobox cbSale (… DataSource: database from M.Sale …) }` kept cbBooking's custom content (txtOptionName, bound to Booking.Name) inside cbSale. check -p and exec passed; with the content type 'yes', mx check: CE1365 "Attribute 'M.Booking.Name' is not an attribute of entity 'M.Sale'" at a widget the author never wrote and describe never printed. On current main describe prints the type, so the replace turns it 'no' and mx check passes on 11.13.0 — with txtOptionName still stored in cbSale, hidden and bound to Booking
cause: The #1247 same-kind REPLACE merge keeps every stored property on which the replacement and a baseline built from describe agree. describe never prints a combo box's custom content, so baseline and replacement are both empty there and the stored widgets are always kept — right while the content's data source keeps its entity, wrong once the statement moves it. The stored Type says which data source the content is built for (ValueType.DataSourceProperty: optionsSourceAssociationCustomContent → optionsSourceAssociationDataSource); the merge never read it
file: mdl/backend/pagemutator/pluggable_replace.go (staleLinkedContent, dataSourceEntity, mergePluggableReplace, CheckPluggableReplace), mdl/backend/stale_widget_content.go (StaleWidgetContentError), mdl/executor/cmd_alter_page.go (pluggableReplaceBaseline, refuseStaleContentReplace), mdl/executor/validate_alter_page_refs.go (check-time call, droppedFirst)
fix: A merge that would keep a Widgets property's stored widgets while the data source it is linked to now names another entity is refused (ADR-0012: carry or refuse, never drop), by exec and by check -p, naming the widgets and the remedy — `drop <names>;` first in the same statement, or drop + insert. check counts drops earlier in the script, since it reads the stored document where exec has already applied them. Same entity (a label, a sort, an XPath) keeps the content as before
test: TestStaleLinkedContent (2 shapes + 4 controls), TestReplacePluggableRefusesStaleContent (refused, nothing written; the check-time question; control after the content is gone), TestDroppedFirstDiscountsTheRecommendedDrop; mdl-examples/bug-tests/1563-replace-combobox-keeps-hidden-custom-content.mdl
insight: **Re-run the repro on main before fixing the reported symptom**: the CE1365 no longer reproduced (describe had since learned to print the content TYPE, so the merge now flipped it to 'no'), but the stored page still held the stale widget — the defect had moved from a build error to an invisible one, which no mx check catches. Dump the stored widget names, not just the error count. **The schema already said which content belongs to which data source** (ValueType.DataSourceProperty in the stored Type); entity comparison, not 'did the data source change', is what separates the refusal from #1247's own case (adding a sort to the same source). **A check-time twin of a refusal must model what exec applies first**: the recommended `drop X; replace …` was refused by check until it counted earlier drops — and a stub of that discount reproduced the false refusal, which is the control that shows it is load-bearing. Found on the way, not fixed here: `create or modify` of a page whose combo box the statement CHANGES silently drops the same custom content (Replaced page, then CE0642 'Custom content is required'); an unchanged combo box survives through the pluggable passthrough
